853:t_35:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Don't say that, Mr. Hardship... I mean, $$シン$$. Let's taste the bitter hardships of this world together!」

853:t_36:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A volley from all the Dragoons at once... Mr. $$キラ$$, you're so good at fighting many enemies that your kill count just keeps climbing.」

853:t_36:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But just between us... don't you ever shoot an ally by mistake?」

853:t_36:7.en:
$$キラ$$
「Don't worry. That's the one thing I'm careful never to let happen.」

853:t_36:8.en:
$$キラ$$
「So, AG... if I ever shoot you, it won't be a misfire. It'll mean I aimed at you and fired on purpose.」

853:t_36:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ha... ha ha ha... Thank you for the subtle threat.」

853:t_36:10.en:
$$キラ$$
「I don't want to do that either, so be careful.」

853:t_37:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I was thinking of sending flowers to celebrate, but...」

853:t_37:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But Mr. $$刹那$$... you like flowers, don't you? You've kept them in your room all this time.」

853:t_37:8.en:
$$刹那$$
「The feelings put into those flowers... they give me strength.」

853:t_37:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'd put my feelings into it, too...」

853:t_37:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh no... I haven't even said anything yet...」

853:t_37:14.en:
$$刹那$$
「In a way, it seems we understand each other.」

853:t_38:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$ロックオン$$!」

853:t_38:4.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Thanks, AG. But I'd like you to say your congratulations to these guys, too.」

853:t_38:5.en:
$$ハロ$$
「$$ロックオン$$, Ace. $$ロックオン$$, Ace.」

853:t_38:6.en:
$$青ハロ$$
「$$ハロ$$, worked hard. $$ハロ$$, worked hard.」

853:t_38:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I know. Congratulations to you, $$ハロ$$, and to you, $$青ハロ$$, too!」

853:t_38:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll take a page from $$ハロ$$'s book and release color-variant versions from now on, and develop it into one big franchise.」

853:t_38:9.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「In that case, you'd make a fine target for my barrage.」

853:t_38:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You say the most outrageous things with such a cool face...」

853:t_39:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$アレルヤ$$!」

853:t_39:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And also Miss $$ピーリス$$, Mr. $$ハレルヤ$$, and Miss $$マリー$$!」

853:t_39:5.en:
$$マリー$$
「It seems we've put you to a lot of trouble.」

853:t_39:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all... But if you're going to thank someone anyway, then rather than Mr. $$アレルヤ$$, how about Hall...」

853:t_39:8.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
「I see, AG! You want me!!」

853:t_39:10.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
「You're the one who requested me, aren't you!? Let's have plenty of fun!」

853:t_39:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I was... just going to say that since it's such a hallowed occasion, it should be Miss $$マリー$$... Why am I getting this treatment...」

853:t_40:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$ティエリア$$!」

853:t_40:6.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Lately, little by little, I've started to understand what you're trying to do.」

853:t_40:7.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「And that it probably overlaps with my mission.」

853:t_40:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Are you sure? Trusting me so easily like that...」

853:t_40:9.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I'll put my faith in the conscience inside you.」

853:t_40:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When you put it like that, it gets hard for me to get up to any mischief...」

853:t_40:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Well... Mr. $$ティエリア$$ does owe me one over the $$ヴェーダ$$ business, though...)

853:t_41:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$グラハム$$!」

853:t_41:4.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I'm a man who once cast away his life. With that resolve, I can do anything.」

853:t_41:6.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I do. I could cut a rude robot in two with a single stroke without a moment's hesitation.」

853:t_41:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ugh... he took the wind out of my sails...」

853:t_41:8.en:
$$グラハム$$
「The one who strikes first controls the other... From now on, I won't let you set the pace.」

853:t_42:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$コーラサワー$$!」

853:t_42:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...I mean, Happy Mr. $$コーラサワー$$!」

853:t_42:5.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「OK, AG. Looks like you're starting to get how things work.」

853:t_42:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, after being made to listen to the stories of Mr. $$コーラサワー$$ and Miss $$マネキン$$ over and over, one can't help but feel that way.」

853:t_42:7.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Let me tell you, that's only the story so far. The future of me and the Colonel... I mean, the Brigadier General stretches on without limit.」

853:t_42:8.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「It's such a happy occasion. Today, I'll tell you all about it.」

853:t_42:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「P-please... keep it to about two hours...」

853:t_43:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$バナージ$$!」

853:t_43:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm still nowhere near there, though.」

853:t_43:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I believe Mr. $$バナージ$$ is the kind of person who keeps stacking up those 'nowhere near's until he reaches a place no one else can reach.」

853:t_43:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please show me. How far Mr. $$バナージ$$ can go.」

853:t_43:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Y-yeah... Somehow AG is really serious today.」

853:t_43:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You and the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$ have something that makes a person feel that way.」

853:t_44:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's presumptuous of someone like me to say anything, but I pray that you will go straight ahead without straying from your path.」

853:t_44:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「If there were such a thing, I'd have been walking it long ago...」

853:t_44:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(This tunnel... looks like it's going to be a long one...)

853:t_45:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You seem to have outgrown your old self.」

853:t_45:6.en:
$$リディ$$
「I wonder... I might still be a kid who doesn't understand anything...」

853:t_45:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「But for now, I intend to keep moving forward, no matter what. To make up for all the detours I've taken until now.」

853:t_45:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Admirable. Please allow me to watch over your battles from here on.」

853:t_45:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Oh no... I got so serious that I couldn't get in my 'Your sin is worth ten thousand Banshees' gag...)
